After that it will be $95 per year.¤†What are the benefits of the American Express Blue Cash Preferred® Card?
With the American Express Blue Cash Preferred® Card, you can earn:
6% cash back on purchases at U.S. supermarkets, on up to $6,000 per year in purchases (then 1%).‡
6% cash back on select U.S. Streaming subscriptions.‡
3% cash back on gas purchases at U.S. gas stations.‡
3% cash back on transit purchases.‡
1% cash back on other eligible purchases.‡
Cash Back is received as Reward Dollars that can be redeemed for a statement credit or for other select options.‡The American Express Blue Cash Preferred® Card also offers a suite of benefits such as, but not limited to:
Disney Streaming Credit: With the $120 Disney Streaming Credit, you can earn up to $10 back per month as a statement credit when you use your enrolled American Express Blue Cash Preferred® Card to purchase a subscription, including a bundle subscription, on DisneyPlus.com, Hulu.com, or Stream.ESPN.com U.S. websites, with no minimum purchase requirement. Subscription is subject to auto-renewal.‡
Help meet your savings goals faster: Turn everyday purchases into future savings. Whether you're stocking up on groceries, filling up your tank, or streaming your favorite show, eligible everyday purchases can help you earn Reward Dollars. Redeem Reward Dollars for a deposit into an American Express® High Yield Savings Account‡. Deposit accounts offered by American Express National Bank. Member FDIC.
Cash Back at Amazon.com checkout: Make the most of Reward Dollars by using them to cover all or part or your everyday purchases at Amazon.com. When checking out with your linked Blue Cash Preferred® Card, apply Reward Dollars toward millions of eligible items.‡
Amex Special Ticket Access: Card Members can access Amex Presale Tickets®‡ and Amex Reserved Tickets®‡ to select can’t-miss events and moments across sports, music, and more.**While supplies last, not all seats may be offered.
